body_markdown:
[huWkffKNBo](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/huWkffKNBo)


September 18, 2026, 7:09am 1


Since upgrading to the latest version of the Android app (v15), I’ve noticed a few regressions that I wanted to highlight.


*For context, my normal Newsblur mobile workflow is that I scroll the ‘Unread Site Stories’ feed (set to ‘Unread - Oldest’), with items automatically marked as read as I pass them, and I open interesting ones to take a look and save ones I want to read later.*


1.


Default long-press story action became ‘Share’, which was very confusing. Until now, long-pressing had always either saved/unsaved or opened an action menu where I could do so (I don’t remember exactly which). I don’t remember if that was built-in or something I had customised, but is it not possible to preserve the existing behaviour by default?


2.


Under Settings → Preferences → Gestures → Story titles, ‘Swipe left’ and ‘Swipe right’ can both be set to ‘Save / unsave’, but ‘Long press’ can only be set to ‘Save’


3.


Opening an item now seems to have more of a delay than before. I can’t get it to reproduce reliably, but sometimes it will take further still—a couple of seconds—with a 'Loading’ notification at the bottom of the screen, which I’d never seen before. I’ll see if I can record it the next time it happens.


4.


Feed names now seem to be the same text size as item names, which is a bit confusing under normal conditions (it took me a while to realise that it wasn’t my feeds’ item titles being mangled):


[Screenshot_20260918-090524 1080×2400 258 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/a/ac45183cad830f6cf3c3f40878fecf57471fe265.png)


…but looks particularly bad in ‘Compact’ mode and on sizes L and above:


[Screenshot_20260918-090546 1080×2400 310 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/e/e5bbb700cdef7028a3bf92e5bc16abf59cae90ca.png)


[Screenshot_20260918-090607 1080×2400 285 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/9/98c18cee960a3063ce96ae86b731a09b44e82124.png)


5.


I couldn’t find any release notes available for the Android app; what else changed in v15?


---


Debug info:


- App version: Newsblur (` com.newsblur` ) 15.0.0, installed from F-Droid
- Device: Google Pixel 8a w/ GrapheneOS v2026091001


[Android: Restore mark older/newer read options for long press](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/android-restore-mark-older-newer-read-options-for-long-press/13837/3)


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


September 18, 2026, 8:05am 2


Amazing, super useful screenshots. It’s in the test track but because you’re on f droid you upgraded immediately. I’m still iterating on it and have some pretty huge updates coming out later today. I’ll take your comments into account. Keep them coming as I put out more updates.
